description: This file primarily exports types, functions, and classes related to the context engine, acting as an index or module entry point for the context engine component.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a new context engine instance.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function for creating context engines.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all available context engine identifiers.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves a specific context engine by ID.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates compaction tasks to the runtime.

methods.name: ensureContextEnginesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures all context engines are initialized.
